How the quiz picks

  • Only tools we checked in the last 30 days, with a verified free-tier listing and a verified starting price. Right now that's 58 listings. Anything we couldn't verify is left out.
  • Free pick: the best free tier for your job that keeps working. One-time credits and trials rank lower, non-commercial free tiers rank lower if you do paid work, and self-hosted tools rank lower if you're new.
  • Paid pick: our highest-ranked tool for the job whose cheapest monthly plan fits your budget. If your budget is $0, there isn't one.
  • Skip: the tool with the clearest reason not to start there for you: no free plan, over budget, a free tier that runs out, or simply more than you need.
  • Every price and free tier is the vendor's own, with the date we checked it. Affiliate deals never affect a pick, and nobody can pay for a spot.

How we check: every price and free tier on this page comes from the vendor's own pricing page, with the date we checked it. If we can't verify something, we say so. Found a wrong price? Email info@usethissi.com and we fix it within 24 hours.
